description: A plan for one district, corridor or neighbourhood: conditions, concepts, a preferred concept, development standards, infrastructure and phasing, and adoption.
scope_notes: This is a standard-practice starting point — edit to your scope. Rename, delete and add records until the list matches the work your agency actually agreed to do.

Every date is calculated forward from the kickoff date you enter. The offsets are round numbers reflecting how this kind of work is usually sequenced — they are placeholders for a real schedule, not commitments.

A specific or area plan usually carries its own environmental review and often its own standards. Those are separate work plans; the review milestone here is only the point at which they must already be underway.
It assumes an area small enough for direct engagement — workshops and a charrette rather than a regional campaign.

No jurisdiction is assumed. Review periods, required notices, hearings and the body that adopts the work are set where you are; none of them are stated here. Add the records your own process requires.
Nobody is assigned. Applying a template never puts a colleague's name on a deadline — assign the records yourself once the team is settled.

deliverables.title: Work plan and engagement approach
deliverables.summary: The task list, the schedule, and how residents, property owners and businesses in the area will be reached.

deliverables.title: Area conditions and opportunities report
deliverables.summary: Land, ownership, buildings, infrastructure, access, environment and market context for the plan area.

deliverables.title: Concept alternatives
deliverables.summary: Illustrated alternatives for land use, mobility and public realm, drawn to be compared.

deliverables.title: Preferred concept and standards outline
deliverables.summary: The direction chosen, with the outline of the development standards that will implement it.

deliverables.title: Draft plan — land use, mobility, public realm and standards
deliverables.summary: The complete draft, including the regulating standards the plan will apply.

deliverables.title: Infrastructure and phasing plan
deliverables.summary: The facilities needed to serve what the plan allows, and the order in which they must arrive.

milestones.title: Project kickoff meeting
milestones.summary: Scope, boundary and engagement approach confirmed.

milestones.title: First community workshop
milestones.summary: The area's residents, owners and businesses describe what the plan must address.

milestones.title: Design charrette
milestones.summary: Alternatives worked through with the community in the room.

milestones.title: Advisory body review of the draft
milestones.summary: The recommending body reviews the draft plan and standards.

milestones.title: Public review of the draft opens
milestones.summary: The draft is released for comment.
